notes.title: Akumi Wars 1.0.29 - (Bug Fixes/ Updates)
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: 

 Halloween and Thanksgiving events removed till holiday season
 X-mas event changed to be part of the story. Changed node unlocks and some cutscenes for this change. Akumizon can be acquired early or late game similar to Tirax's quest
 Dev node removed. Was accidentally left active. If you got the X-merc reward there, you keep them, they are now rare

 Ronin Armor skin is now unlockable on Soybean hero

notes.title: Akumi Wars 1.0.28 - (Bug Fixes/ Updates)
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: 

 Possible fix for some achievements not registering
 Possible fix for inventory/game loading bug when an inventory is extremely full. Would cause a bug which made items overflow into a new game save while not being useable
 Removed ambiguous keyboard devices from being detected. Was being treated like a controller causing a game lock-up bugGame Updates:

notes.title: Akumi Wars 1.0.27 - (Multiple Bug Fixes & Updates)
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: - Seasonal Events Leaving January 31, 2025


 Fixed a “create new game” bug related to ship skill not being loaded correctly
 Fixed another “create new game” bug if you returned to the main title screen and created a new game it would not load after the tutorial cutscene
 Fixed a bug related to hit impact objects being destroyed but game trying to access them
 Fixed skill name displays in the upgrade shop. Was displaying wrong names
 Remade player Fishman to a new character, Fin. Was missing his deploy animation. If you had Fishman, he will disappear from your inventory.  Can be acquired again at Colosseum or secret node in Stoneshore
 Frost Elf and Water Elf can now manually cast Nature’s Gift skill. Was a precast skill
 Fixed Frost Elf’s Frost Bolt. It was hitting random targets
 Fixed Water Elf’s stats. Was using boss enemy stats
 Fixed “Superior Defense”. Wasn’t giving magic defense
 Removed use restrictions on “Blood Fiend” custom skills 
 Party Cleanse V - Cleanses all debuffs from enemies and now heals
 Mass Taunt V - Taunts all enemies for 2 turns! But this mass taunt can be resisted
 Unbreakable no longer dispels buffs on you and your party when attacking
 Killer Instinct now increases in damage as well as in life steal
 Sound effects now all have a pitch shift variable, randomly shifting the pitch of all sounds in the game
 Removed X-merc drop from X-mas node. Akumizon is already very powerful, X-merc was a duplicate of her. If you got her before this patch, you keep her
 Blood Slime is now red. Was using the wrong skin
 Fixed Death Marker skills. It was not showing up in the upgrade shop although it was upgradable. Unholy Sacrifice has upgrade tag removed

Map Changes:
 Fixed Mana Fly Pet reward. Was giving out infinite Mana Fly Pets
 Revamped ship upgrade cutscenes with Dwarf Engineer, Grizzlespit
 Defeating Nyssa now gives a choice between strong precast skills: God’s Grace, Mass Invisibility and Mass Initiative

New Skills that can be found in shops and as drops:

 God’s Grace - Precast. The gods smile upon you. All party members are protected from death for 3 turns. The first turn will cast invincibility on the caster for 1 turn. (Cannot be removed.)
 Mass Invisibility - Precast. Casts invisibility on all party members for 3 turns.  (Cannot be removed.)
 Mass Initiative - Precast. Mass turn meter and attack speed increase.

Want to help us continue improving Akumi games? Join the Akumi Wars Discord!

Onwards and Upwards!
-Akumi Wars Team

notes.title: Akumi Wars 1.0.8 - Softlock Patch
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
• Found a key component causing a major game freeze/softlock bug. Bug happened when knocking down and killing an enemy that has self-resurrection, for example all zombies. Engine put the “death” and “resurrection” statuses out of order confusing it and causing the engine to wait for an enemy’s turn that had already died. There could be other ways to softlock the game we haven't discovered yet. If it happens to you, press control+F11 and screen capture the green text log so we can better see what happened. You can report bugs to the Akumi Wars Discord bugs channel. Thank you!
• Removed normal Stumpy’s “Barkskin” when below 50% hp.
• Replaced Arcane Mage with Mage Apprentice during Mareoceu fight.
New Stuffs
• Added new skill "Gwen’s Curse" to all shops: A curse crafted by the young lich, Gwen. Casts extinction on a single target for 3 turns! If a target is killed with this debuff, they cannot resurrect. Cooldown: 13 (Also applies Death Curse II damaging 50% of target's max HP after 2 turns!)  Well that’s convenient!
• Molly buff - Now ALL of Molly's attacks ignore dodge and counterattacks.
• Lila now opens an upgrade shop expansion in zone 1. I feel it took too long for players to gain access to upgrading skills. (Must visit Lila’s shop to unlock her upgrade add-on.)

Let's continue to improve Akumi Wars.
Onwards and Upwards!
-Akumi Wars Team

notes.title: Akumi Wars 1.0.1 Patch #1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
• Achievements “should”  be working again. Needs to be tested on live game. Let us know if they work after you play this patch!
• Most playable heroes and enemies now have background descriptions
• Lanz ultimate skill description corrected. Was using Azumi’s description
• Fixed counterattack bug. Was attacking twice causing a softlock
• Fixed infinite invincibility bug that would happen in certain circumstances
• Movies now play to the end but there’s still a starting glitch in the movies we need to figure out in the Unity player.
• Looking into a softlock bug that started happening to a player 
• Minor grammar fixes

Bounty Hunter Buffs:
• Buffed all bounty hunter attacks.
• All Bounty Hunters have the passive “Advantage”. (Advantage: your critical damage increases 20% with each hit. Max stacks: 50. When an enemy is knocked down, you gain a 50% critical chance. Cooldown: 3 turns.)
• “Bleeding Strike” -  last hit now applies weaken.
• “Fire Attack” - Shoot your target 4 times causing burn. A second enemy with the lowest hp also gets burned.
• “Bounty Breaker” and “Bounty Frenzy” - last hit causes knockdown.
• “Power Strike” - in addition to knockdown it now also stuns on the last hit. This attack also increases your dodge chance.
• “Shockwave” - has a higher chance to knockdown multiple enemies. This attack also increases your dodge chance.
• “Bounty Shots” and “Rapid Fire” - Shoot multiple times at a single target multiple. Damage increases the lower your target's health. 

Please report any bugs you find to the bugs channel on the 
Akumi Wars Discord: https://discord.gg/dj37MyRaxn

Onwards and Upwards!
-Akumi Wars Team
